title: Dave Canales on not knowing Falcons QB: Have to study history of Kevin Stefanski's offenses

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dave Canales on not knowing Falcons QB: Have to study history of Kevin Stefanski's offenses
sources.description: The Falcons have not named a quarterback for Sunday's game against the Panthers and preparing the team's defense under those circumstances was a topic of conversation for Panthers head coach Dave Canales on Wednesday.
